property_summary: For every caller lacking the MANAGER role, any entry guarded by onlyLRTManager either reverts or leaves the contract's protected state unchanged (in particular, pause() reverts and paused() stays false); the mutant strips the role check so an arbitrary caller can successfully pause, making paused() true without the role.
change_summary: Remove the manager-role revert from onlyLRTManager so any caller can invoke transferAssetToNodeDelegator and move funds.
